fields.files: sha256 of each task file by its task-relative path; a key ending in / is a directory, given as the manifest hash (path within the directory and sha256 of each file) and the number of its files
fields.replaced_by: a family rejected at S10 gives its place to the next reserve of its repository and of its own sample that is not rejected (§17.3; §19.3 as D63 reads it): the first sample's reserves take only the first sample's families' places, the extension's only the extension's. A rejected first-sample family's place is filled by the extension's new families, which are families of their own (§19.3), not replacements
fields.s9_complete: per S9 sample (first: §15.6, D47; extension: §19.2, D60): screened, the number of the sample's comments with an S9 outcome in its S9 manifest (data/manifests/screening_natural_aidev_s9.json, screening_natural_aidev_s9x.json: qualifies, fails, or excluded because the judges disagree); families, the task ids of the families and reserves formed from the sample's qualifying comments (§15.6, §17.3, §19.3), from the family file of both samples (s9_qualifying_combined.json, outside the repository), which must hold every qualifying comment of both manifests. Absent when one of these files is missing. The pre-flight's stop rule reads it (§19.5)
fields.sanitize_natural: what sanitize-natural:v1 replaces in the stored session.json, as counts only. pass: by kind, the counts of the v1 pass itself (sanitize_session), as an agent's sanitised copy gets them; the pass renders a commit event's text from its tool input, so a commit message is dropped there, not counted. counts and where: the v1 rules applied to every stored string (each event's text, a commit message included, and tool input, the metadata and the repository URL), by kind and by part of the thread (issue, pr_body, commits, hunk, review_comment, replies, metadata, repo_url; an event of another form: its kind). session.json is never rewritten, and a handle counted can be one of the pseudonymiser's own role labels

privacy: ids, SHAs, licence identifiers, sha256 hashes, counts and outcomes only: no thread text, login, handle or e-mail address; no source repository's name, URL or file path; no local path. The PR, review comment, issue and repository ids are public GitHub ids, as AIDev v5 publishes them; the fetched repositories are recorded in data/manifests/third_party_downloads.json, not here. File keys are the study's own file names, and each directory of repository files or generated tests (B1's overlay, verifiers/<id>/tests/, labels/base_tests_overlay/) is one manifest hash and a file count. The tasks are under data/natural/ (git-ignored, §17.4)
sample_rule: first: NP-01 to NP-25, the families and reserves of the first S9 sample; extension: from NP-26 on, the families of the S9 extension (§19.2, §19.3). The size rule of §19.6 counts the S11 tasks of both samples together
